collection_wrapper.purpose: Describe the bound collection specification and blocked-training metadata through existing wrapper functions.

registry_declared_slot.purpose: Preserve the declared registry job, inputs, outputs and target functions without treating them as implemented code.

runtime_model_program.purpose: Bind the observed runtime model program, including any source-defined fallback, without invoking it.

synthetic_research_program.purpose: Bind the existing synthetic or offline research program; generated samples and fit metrics do not establish market outcomes.

registry_binding.title: Registry identity and declarations
inputs: Observed registry projection and module specification, when present.
outputs: Exact bot identity, registered role, declared input collections, storage targets and target functions.

metadata_description.title: Collection description
inputs: Bound BOT_SPEC and describe_bot source definition, if present.
outputs: Source-defined collection metadata description; observed output requires a separate receipt.

blocked_training_metadata.title: Blocked-training descriptor
inputs: Bound BOT_SPEC and train_brain wrapper definition, if present.
outputs: Existing metadata-only blocked-training response; thresholds are declarations, not model-fit evidence.

program_entrypoints.title: Program entrypoints and observed trainer calls
inputs: Observed entrypoint signatures, trainer call expressions and exact source parameters.
outputs: Source references describing the existing program and any fallback; no execution sequence is inferred.

input_validation.title: Input validation requirements and source references
inputs: Observed input-validation functions or callback expressions and exact source input declarations; shared-helper checks may have no local reference.
outputs: Source references for input acceptance or rejection, or an explicit gap. This authored requirement does not certify schema, sample sufficiency, freshness or lineage checks.

feature_definition.title: Feature functions and callback expressions
inputs: Observed feature callbacks, named feature functions and literal input keys.
outputs: Exact feature source references or an explicit local-reference gap; names alone do not prove call wiring.

label_definition.title: Label functions and callback expressions
inputs: Observed label callbacks, local label functions and registry label declarations.
outputs: Exact label source references or an explicit local-reference gap; sample horizons retain their source units.

filter_definition.title: Sample filters and confidence functions
inputs: Observed filter and confidence callbacks, local functions and source selection expressions.
outputs: Exact source references or an explicit local-reference gap; no empirical regime support is inferred.

evaluation.title: Evaluation requirements and source references
inputs: Observed evaluation functions or callbacks and exact source prediction, label, split and metric declarations when present.
outputs: Source references describing evaluation or an explicit gap. Evaluation outcomes, failures, untouched tests and economic performance require separate evidence; none are inferred from this authored stage.

output_publication.title: Output publication and failure evidence requirements
inputs: Observed artifact-writing functions or publication callbacks and source-defined output declarations when present.
outputs: Source references or an explicit publication gap. Completion requires independent owner evidence of the actual output; failed or partial publication cannot earn completion from this definition. Persistence, cleanup, recovery and retry behavior remain source-defined and unverified.

completion_evidence.title: Definition receipt and outstanding evidence
inputs: Validated authored graph, observed binding and explicit source-reference gaps.
outputs: Policy and binding digests; runtime completion, conformance and economic evidence remain unverified.
